meta.label: Application-layer role profiles
meta.disclaimer: These 12 role profiles are NOT part of the RM Comp framework in the source PDF. They are an assessment-navigation / relevance-weighting layer created for this tool, used only to decide which competencies get more or fewer adaptive questions and to suggest (never impose) a starting target-level default. Users can always request the Full RM Comp Assessment mode, which ignores relevance weighting and assesses every competency equally.
meta.targetLevelGuidanceNote: targetLevelByExperience is only a starting suggestion shown to the user during the Target Role step. It is never applied automatically — the user explicitly confirms or overrides the target level for their current and/or desired role.

profiles.name: Research Support
profiles.description: Provides general support to researchers and research projects, often across multiple stages of the research lifecycle, without deep specialisation in one area.

profiles.name: Grant/Proposal Management
profiles.description: Focuses on identifying funding opportunities and developing competitive, compliant funding proposals (pre-award).

profiles.name: Post-Award Management
profiles.description: Manages funded projects after award: contracting, compliance, financial and consortium management, reporting.

profiles.name: Research Project Management
profiles.description: Leads day-to-day delivery of research projects: planning, deliverables, risk, teams, and stakeholder coordination.

profiles.name: Research Strategy & Policy
profiles.description: Shapes institutional research strategy, policy development, and research assessment frameworks.

profiles.name: Research Infrastructure
profiles.description: Plans, operates, and sustains physical, virtual, and data research infrastructures.

profiles.name: Research Finance
profiles.description: Oversees budgetary, financial planning, and compliance aspects of research funding and projects.

profiles.name: Research Leadership
profiles.description: Senior/director-level responsibility spanning strategy, people leadership, and organisational impact across the research management function.

profiles.name: Research Administration
profiles.description: Handles operational, administrative, and compliance processes underpinning research activity (contracts, records, systems, HR-adjacent processes).

profiles.name: Research Talent Development
profiles.description: Focuses on developing research staff capability: coaching, mentoring, career pathways, and HR-aligned initiatives for researchers.

profiles.name: Research Communication / Stakeholder Management
profiles.description: Leads dissemination, media, communications planning, and relationship management with funders, partners, and communities.

profiles.name: Research Support Office Management
profiles.description: Manages the research/grant support office itself: its structure, staff, service strategy, and continuous improvement.
